title: Giza pink granite hauled 500 miles from Aswan
place_text: Giza Plateau and Aswan quarry, Egypt

tellings.quote: all the pink GR it we find throughout the Giza Plateau came from 500 miles away to the south in the Awan Quarry

plain: All the pink granite found across the Giza plateau in Egypt came from the Aswan quarry, about 500 miles to the south. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells this. He uses it to show how far the builders moved huge blocks of stone, and how hard that would have been.
